description.zh:
实例ID。

> 您可以调用[DescribeDBInstances](~~86911~~)接口查看目标地域下所有的AnalyticDB PostgreSQL实例的详情，包括实例ID。
description.en:
The cluster ID.

>  You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](~~86911~~) operation to query the information about all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances within a region, including instance IDs.

description.zh: 查询结束时间，需要大于查询开始时间，格式为yyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）。 默认为当前时间。
description.en:
The end of the time range to query. The time must be in UTC and formatted as *yyyy-MM-dd*T*HH:mm*Z. The time must be in UTC. The end time must be later than the start time.

Defaults to the current time
The longest execution duration. Unit: seconds.
The minimum execution duration. Unit: seconds.
The region ID of the instance.

description.zh: 查询开始时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）。 默认为当前时间 - 5min。
description.en:
The beginning of the time range to query. The time must be in UTC and formatted as *yyyy-MM-dd*T*HH:mm*Z.

Defaults to the current time minus 5 minutes.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun gpdb download-slow-sql-records --db-instance-id gp-xxxxxxxxx --db-name testdb01 --user-name test_user --start-time 2024-12-04T16:00:00Z --end-time 2024-12-04T17:00:00Z --keyword SELECT --min-duration 10 --max-duration 600 --order-by Field:_SchemaName,_Type:_Desc --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun gpdb DownloadSlowSQLRecords --region cn-hangzhou --OrderBy 'Field:_SchemaName,_Type:_Desc' --UserName test_user --EndTime '2024-12-04T17:00:00Z' --Keyword SELECT --DBInstanceId 'gp-xxxxxxxxx' --StartTime '2024-12-04T16:00:00Z' --MaxDuration 600 --DBName testdb01 --MinDuration 10 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
